item.title: Ivan pour Droit au vélo NC
item.description: With over 20 years of experience in web development, I consider myself a generalist who thrives on both creative and technical challenges. I develop innovative, interactive solutions by combining strong design sensibilities with deep technical expertise, honed through formal education and professional roles in internet marketing agencies. My experience also includes dynamic site management, Agile project management, technical documentation, and web accessibility compliance. I am comfortable with campaign analytics, SEO, and GDPR standards. My ability to blend creativity with technical depth has been a consistent asset, and I look forward to applying this to innovative, high-impact projects.
